correctness.rationale: For the 12-facet norm N_12, every admissible pair (x,y), N(x)=N(y)=N(x-y)=1, lies in a triple tight-facet face of the 36-inequality polytope P in R4. Exact inspected Q(sqrt 3) checker was reconstructed and RUN independently: all 12^3=1728 facet triples, 168 nonempty faces (144 points and 24 line segments), with endpoint extrema M1=sqrt 3, M2=3. Along each line segment A=N(x+y), B=N(2x-y) are nonnegative convex functions, so linear and quadratic objectives are convex with endpoint maxima. Explicit (x,y)=((1,sqrt3-2),(sqrt3-1,sqrt3-1)) has all three unit norms and A=B=sqrt3. Concavity of sqrt gives M3<=sqrt(M1)=3^(1/4), attained at witness. Thus the numerical claim is correct; no finite sample substitutes for exhaustive polyhedral face proof.
